item.title: Mitsubishi is electrified (again)
item.description: MITSUBISHI MOTORS Philippines Corp. (MMPC) formally launched the all-new Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV (plug-in hybrid electric vehicle) SUV recently in Quezon City — highly touted as Japan’s best-selling PHEV SUV.

item.description: MAZDA PHILIPPINES recently unveiled the all-new Mazda CX-5 crossover, billed as a 2027 model. item.title: Experiencing Xpeng
item.description: GUANGZHOU, Guangdong-headquartered electric vehicle manufacturer Xpeng expressed its readiness to enter the Philippine market and compete with the biggest names in the industry.

item.title: GAC GN6 enters family MPV market
item.description: GAC Philippines has opened reservations for the all-new GN6, a seven-seat gasoline MPV aimed at families that need more room without moving into the higher price range of larger models.

item.title: XPENG sets Phl debut with X9, L03
item.description: XPENG will enter the Philippine market in September with two vehicles that put artificial intelligence at the center of its pitch to local buyers.

item.title: Cars that warn each other
item.description: Our cars already talk to one another through their horns. In the Philippines, however, a short beep can feel personal and a long one can sound like a declaration of war, perhaps because we have watched too many teleseryes.

item.title: Here's How Much A Chevy Corvette Would Have Set You Back In The '70s
item.description: The '70s saw the Chevy Corvette transition from its best period to arguably its worst. Here's what buyers were getting for their buck as the decade progressed.

item.title: Porsche Finds Yet Another Way to Shed Weight, and It’s in Sound Systems
